turnaround_reason: Digital engineering powerhouse crushed from $222 to $73 (67% drawdown) over the past two years as the Ukraine war disrupted its Belarus/Ukraine-centric delivery model. Stock has based around $100 with consistent earnings beats (3 consecutive positive surprises) and revenue growth stabilizing at +4.5%. The thesis is that EPAM has successfully rebased its delivery footprint to lower-risk geographies, AI demand is driving a new services cycle, and the market hasn't yet re-rated the multiple back to historical norms.
bullish_points: Forward PE of 7.2x on a profitable tech services company — extremely cheap for a business with 29% gross margins and 11% operating margins
Trailing PE 13.8x, EV/EBITDA 6.0x, EV/Revenue 0.81x — all well below historical averages for a high-quality IT services firm
3 consecutive earnings beats (7.6%, 3.8%, 3.2% surprises) — estimates are too low and the business is executing
Net cash position: $789M cash vs $152M debt — fortress balance sheet, no leverage risk
17 analysts cover the stock with mean target $123 (21% upside) and high target $200 (97% upside)
Analyst recommendation 'buy' — the street is bullish but the stock hasn't responded to recent beats
Free cash flow of $650M against $5.2B market cap = 12.4% FCF yield
Screen mode 'basing' — 5% above 200-day MA and close to 100-day MA (97.4%), suggesting consolidation before potential breakout
bearish_points: Still 29% below the 200-day MA — significant overhead supply to work through
Revenue growth of +4.5% is anemic by EPAM historical standards (used to grow 20%+)
Short interest 22.3% of float — a significant bearish bet that the basing pattern fails
No insider buying in the last 6 months — only stock award grants, no open-market purchases
Web search unavailable — unable to verify current geopolitical risk premium or AI services revenue trajectory; analysis based solely on dossier data
Geopolitical risk remains — any escalation in Eastern Europe could re-disrupt delivery operations
Basing patterns can fail — without a hard catalyst, this could be a value trap if growth doesn't re-accelerate
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings on November 5 — if EPAM shows revenue growth acceleration (toward high single digits) and comments on AI-driven demand, the market could re-rate the multiple aggressively from current depressed levels
suggested_trade: Starter spot position now (small-to-medium) ahead of Q3 earnings. The risk/reward is favorable at 7x forward earnings with a net cash balance sheet. Add aggressively on a pullback to $90-95 if the 100-day MA is retested. Consider Jan 2027 $110-120 calls if options liquidity permits — but note OI is modest (3,149 calls).
key_risk: Revenue growth fails to accelerate beyond mid-single digits and the market continues to assign a depressed multiple to a 'former growth' story — the basing pattern fails and it retests $73
would_skip_if: Q3 earnings show revenue growth decelerating below 4% or operating margin compression, suggesting the turnaround thesis is not materializing
